The entire original jade bangle and its contour are also hard-protected. Integrate the new hands around these fixed original props; do not repaint or reposition them. Extend the existing blouse naturally from its current horizontal cut at y1046 through the bottom frame edge y1080. Match the exact existing blue fabric, white flowers, front placket/buttons, contour and soft folds. The completed blouse continues outside the frame with no visible horizontal cutoff inside it. Do not change torso size, posture, shoulders, sleeves or arms.

Maintain the existing delicate hand-drawn animated illustration style, soft neutral shading, mature elderly character identity, and genuine alpha transparency. Preserve every black-mask region and all unedited pixels. Create exactly one repaired candidate, not a new pose or a comparison sheet.
